verdict.rationale: mParticle documents real APIs for querying/ingesting data (Real-time API, Warehouse Sync API) and for creating audiences (Platform Audiences API, Composable Audiences), but the documented activation step explicitly requires dashboard navigation ('Navigate to Data Platform > Setup > Directory, and click the card for your audience partner') rather than a pure API call, and there is no mention of an MCP server or agent-native interface anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: MCP server/agent interface, documented API-only audience activation (currently dashboard-driven), and any hands-on evidence of an agent performing this end-to-end.
